The '''Malthor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]].
